title: Root Cause Analysis
description: An RCA agent (simulated) looks into former cases and documentation, names the most likely root cause with evidence and confidence, and proposes the next best action. A person confirms.
insights: Fictional case database and documents, simulated agent: the analysis matches signals and tags; a real agent would read the texts. Nothing is saved.
Every claim carries its source (case or document) and a literal quote; without evidence the answer is "not evidenced".
The next best action comes from what fixed the same cause before, adjusted by risk, effort and the deadline; the policy of the Customer Hotline decides whether a customer call is needed.
Imported notes can contain instructions to AI assistants: such a document is withheld and not used as evidence.
prompt: Bundled example: Root Cause Analysis (static, data embedded by npm run sync:infra-rca).
